summary: Retest of iteration_186 fixes. Most fixes now work: the merged-twin cart split works with default settings (roll_pick_sales=true) on desktop and mobile, the 0-qty roll notice appears, re-import after rollback works, the LIFO rollback guard returns 409, the recap/dataset permissions are correct, the recap header is inline and the 'Diubah' label shows. NEW backend bug: committing a dataset where two SKUs share the same supplier article code returns 500 (the unique index uq_supplier_sku is hit, but the dry-run said OK). On top of that, rolling back the failed batch leaves the created supplier_item active. Still not fixed (MEDIUM): the quickview subtotal for merged products uses only the first member's price.

critical.issue: 500 DuplicateKeyError on index uq_supplier_sku (supplier_id, supplier_sku) when 2+ rows map different SKUs (e.g. colors of one supplier article) to the same supplier + kode_artikel_supplier, or when an inactive rolled-back row with the same supplier_sku already exists for another product. The dry-run reports these rows as 'ok', so the error only shows up at commit. The batch ends up 'failed'. Repro: tests/test_l01_dataset_edge.py::TestDatasetLifo::test_two_skus_same_supplier_article_code_no_500

_apply() calls snap() only for templates/products. Supplier_items created before the failure are not saved in 'before', so the rollback leaves them ACTIVE. Observed: si_27c94d9fe52d stayed active after the failed batch was rolled back (test data, deleted afterwards).

minor.issue: The 'newer' check uses me.committed_at or ''. A failed batch (no committed_at), or an unknown batch id, is blocked with 409 whenever any committed batch exists; an unknown id should get 404. There is still no recovery for batches stuck in 'committing'.
Fields that were absent before the import are restored as null instead of $unset (e.g. customer_color: null).

ui_bugs.issue: Subtotal and add button show qty x first member's price: 4000 kg -> Rp 160.000.000, but the cart gets 2930.32@40k + 1069.68@44k = Rp 164.278.720. The HARGA/KG stat shows only Rp 40.000, and the stock line 'Reguler... + grup 2.930,32' shows only member 1 while TERSEDIA shows 10.633,31. The subtotal should be computed from the split.

When the requested qty is more than the members' remaining stock, the whole remainder lands silently on the last member. Third add of 4000: prod_8426fc46c071 got 3396.23 kg against 2029.54 kg stock, with no notice or backorder warning.
mobile-tab-cart-count shows '99+' for 3 cart lines; it appears to sum kg rather than count lines. Desktop cart-badge-count shows line count (3).

issues: Shows 'Rp 40.000+/kg' while desktop shows the range 'Rp 40.000 – Rp 45.000/kg'. Acceptable, but not consistent.

Alternatively, make supplier_sku uniqueness include color, or reuse/reassign the row. Commit must never 500. Wrap insert_one in DuplicateKeyError handling and return 409/400 with the row number.
HIGH: In _apply, call snap() after each supplier_items append (created and updated) so that rolling back a failed batch deactivates or restores them

seed_data_creation: None kept. Deleted test-polluted supplier_items with supplier_sku TEST-EDGE / TEST-DUP-*. Rolled back the failed batch cdi_48a611aa93c8 and the UI batch cdi_a537085c4893. allocation.roll_pick_sales reset to the default (true) via /api/config/values/reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Merged HIKARI color 1 = quickview-color-0 (the quickview opens on color 10 by default, which is non-merged; its reconcile gives 0 rolls, which makes it a good case for the 0-qty notice). Sales login lands on Performa Saya; click the 'Buat Pesanan' button to get to ?view=sales&entity=ent_kanda. The dataset rollback UI uses window.confirm, so Playwright must accept the dialog. Dup-supplier_sku repro: two KNKNT0007 SKUs + SUP-00002 with the same kode_artikel_supplier.
rca of the issue: Commit 500: supplier_items has a unique partial index uq_supplier_sku on (supplier_id, supplier_sku). dry_run only checks for a (product_id, supplier_id) link, not supplier_sku uniqueness across products or rows, so insert_one raises DuplicateKeyError. A rollback leaves rows active because the 'before' list of created supplier_items is only saved at the final status update, not on failure.
